newsitem.title: USA: Sabratek Q3 sales, net beat expectations.
newsitem.headline: Sabratek Q3 sales, net beat expectations.

text.p: Sabratek Corp said Friday its third quarter sales and net income beat its expectations.
Sabratek develops, makes and markets interactive therapeutic and diagnostic medical systems for the alternate-site healthcare market.

Sabratek reported third quarter sales of $4.9 million, up from $640,000 a year ago. Net income rose to $394,000 or $0.04 a share, from a loss of $1.5 million or $0.36 a share last year on fewer shares outstanding. Operating income was $112,000, compared with a year-ago operating loss of $1.4 million.
Sabratek said its results mark the third consecutive quarter of record sales and operating profitability and its first quarter of net profitability.

"We are extremely pleased that during our first full quarter as a publicly traded company our results have significantly exceeded expectations for both sales and net income," K. Shan Padda, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "These results confirm the strength of our product line and illustrate its continued market acceptance."
